in_marathi.name: Prakhar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Intelligence, Wisdom, Clear Vision
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prakhar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Prakhar means the one who is intelligent, wise, and has clear vision. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'prakar' which means clear or open. It is also associated with the Sun and the light, symbolizing the radiance and brightness of the mind.
